title: identity.member.invited.v1
description: An owner or admin invited an email to the org (synthwerk#37). Written for every accepted invite, also for an email of a user of another org: the event never shows whether the email has an account. CloudEvents subject: the invitation id. The orgid extension holds org_id. actor: user:<sub> of the owner or admin. No email, no subject id of the invitee.

role.description: Org role the invitee gets on the first sign-in.
